description: Read dependency manifests and lockfiles, query the public OSV.dev database for the exact versions found and report known public advisories. Returns a text summary and the inventory, findings, coverage errors and limitations as structuredContent. Read-only: no package manager runs, no writes and no telemetry. Unavailable on a server started in offline mode: the call is refused with VGL-OFFLINE instead of returning an empty audit.

includeDev.description: Also query dev dependencies. Defaults to true.

maxPackages.description: Maximum distinct packages to query (default 200, capped at 1000).

osvBaseUrl.description: Override the OSV API root. Defaults to https://api.osv.dev; must be https, or http on a loopback host (127.0.0.1, ::1, localhost). Credentials in the URL are refused.

path.description: Directory or repository to audit. Defaults to the server's project root.

name: vigil_dependencies
title: Audit dependency advisories with Vigil
